messages:
oliver: Heads-up: aligning TS/Go SDKs on the new routing header and quota attribution changes. We need a small breaking change in TS to accept route metadata as an object instead of a flat header.
yana: Why not keep the header but tighten validation? Consumers currently jam lots of stuff into X-RW-ROUTE.
oliver: We've hit parsing hell in the proxy. Proposal: shift to X-RW-ROUTE-META with compact base64-json encoded payload, and SDKs expose a typed `routeMeta` param.
priya: From console side, we need stable keys to map to tenant quotas. If routeMeta is arbitrary object we risk inconsistent attribution. Can we require `service` and `route_id` fields?
oliver: yes enforce schema v1: {"service": string, "route_id": string, "tags": [string]}. SDKs should validate and serialize. Server will ignore unknown keys.
yana: TS SDK API suggestion:
```
client.request({ model: 'redwood/fast', prompt, routeMeta: { service: 'payments', route_id: 'charge_v2', tags: ['mobile'] } })
```
Will add compile-time types.
sam: breaking change impact: a lot of users call `headers['X-RW-ROUTE']=...` manually. How to migrate?
oliver: plan: 1) add compat layer in SDK: if routeMeta missing, read legacy header and try to parse. Emit console deprecation warning. 2) bump minor, document migration. 3) server accepts both headers for 3 months, then deprecate old one.
priya: dashboard work: need to map old route strings to schema to preserve historic quota charts. Ops will run a translation job during the canary window.
dev-bot: canary deploy of ts-sdk 2.5.0-alpha at 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z
yana: tests: unit for serialization, e2e against proxy parsing, and a migration test to ensure legacy headers are interpreted into routeMeta. Also add lint rule to discourage manual header uses.
sam: sounds fine. One more: quota enforcement uses route fingerprinting; ensure route_id uniqueness constraints documented to avoid cross-tenant collisions.
oliver: agreed. We'll require tenant-scoped route_id or include tenant prefix. Add runtime check that route_id length <128 and allowed chars.
priya: ops: we will surface a console flag 'legacy route header mode' so admins can opt-in during transition. Also add a notice in quota alerts when translation was used.
yana: timeline: two-week canary -> 4-week passive monitor -> old header soft-deprecate. I'll open PRs for types and the compat shim.
oliver: thanks. I'll draft the SDK changelog blurb and a short migration guide.
priya: I'll coordinate the translation job and dashboard mapping.
wendy: (DM) legal asked to include a short note about metadata retention in the migration doc.
oliver: noted, will add.
priya: okay no blockers. Proceeding with plan.
